plugins.name: spec-first
plugins.description: Spec-first workflow: the project owner sets intent and acceptance criteria; Claude orchestrates an autonomous run - sub-agents all on Opus, effort high at least, every test suite run once per tree - until the criteria are developed and merged, then a review that judges them all (six reviewers, live testers in parallel), then a clean-up and a clear end.
